AFTER THE FACT -- splitting the population instead of dismissing it
(i) THE GEOMETRY HYPOTHESIS CANNOT BE THE WHOLE ANSWER, and loop 119 is why.
Protein HALF-LIFE predicts the CCD call at AUC 0.5999 -- measured by SILAC mass
spectrometry in mouse fibroblasts, an instrument with no camera in it and no
connection to the imaging that made the call. A pure localisation artefact has no
reason to track turnover in a different species by a different method. So genuine
abundance change is part of this population.
(ii) SO SPLIT IT AT THE BOUND. Above the half-life threshold no mechanism in the
equation can reach 20%; below it, they all can.
